Exact original NW physical display projection, ordinary untouched source rectangle

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: OpenTTD robot16 ORIGINAL ROOF DISPLAY status components, corrected genuine W and NW.
Input1 is an EXACT UNTOUCHED close-up of its approved W display. Its long screen edges RISE TO THE RIGHT: lower-left to upper-right, not descending. Navy face is a narrow sloped parallelogram on the original ivory roof. Input2 is an EXACT UNTOUCHED close-up of the approved NW display. Its long face edges also RISE TO THE RIGHT, a broad low diamond/parallelogram in the genuine NW projection. These two close-ups are the physical geometry authority. Keep those real camera projections and upper-left SCREEN illumination. Do not use the wrong clockwise/down-right slope from an E/NE view. Never flat-flip/rotate a bitmap: render the same original physical face from its approved W/NW camera with correct light/edge thickness.
Render ONLY each original flat navy display and its existing narrow ivory edge, no surrounding roof/hull, extra screws/dots/LEDs/housing or new hardware. Exactly SIX separate cutouts in TWO ROWS of THREE. TOP ROW genuine W geometry from input1, BOTTOM ROW genuine NW geometry from input2. Each row LEFT blocked with one broad short AMBER bar; MIDDLE serviceA with one broad bright CYAN bar at the LOWER-LEFT end of the existing face, other end dark; RIGHT serviceB with CYAN at the OPPOSITE UPPER-RIGHT end, lower-left now dark. Same physical display/frame/aspect/position/projection in all3states of each row. True different source illumination, no work or moving/opened equipment. Bars confined to the existing navy face, crisp about45-60px long and20px thick, no glow/halo/extra indicator dot/text/symbols.
1536x1024 TRUE-TRANSPARENT sheet. One pure-magenta6px exterior rectangle per row: W(24,24)-(1512,488); NW(24,536)-(1512,1000). Centers top(256,256),(768,256),(1280,256); bottom(256,768),(768,768),(1280,768). Each COMPLETE display max240px wide/160px tall, comfortably within its own safe rectangle x80..432/592..944/1104..1456 with y80..432 forW or592..944 forNW. At least40px true-transparent clearance around each subject and all frames. Small separated complete components, no connected triplets, clipping or overlap.
Empty background/interiors/margins/gutters actual alpha=0, no purple haze/checkerboard/gray-white fill/background/castshadow. Magenta ONLY exterior frames. No labels/numbers/arrows/watermark/otherprops. Crucial: correct original W and NW display faces slope from LOWER LEFT TO UPPER RIGHT, keeping original physical proportions, fixed upper-left light and one identical original display per actual state.

layout_review.camera: Both physical display long edges rise to the right, matching actual W/NW originals; fixed screen upper-left light and original navy-face geometry.
layout_review.part_policy: Ordinary central original navy-face/bar rectangles, uniformly registered to frozen original native screen masks. No source/background repair or original body/opacity edit.
